description: This file defines API routes for task management in a project management backend, including listing, creating, updating, reordering, and deleting tasks, using FastAPI framework with database interactions.

methods.name: dict _get_current_user_payload(authorization: Optional[str] = Header(default=None))
methods.description: Extracts and validates user info from Bearer token, raising HTTP 401 if invalid or missing.

methods.name: None _assert_project_in_org(conn, project_id: Optional[str], org_id: str)
methods.description: Checks if a project belongs to the current organization, raising HTTP 404 if not.

methods.name: List[Task] list_tasks( payload: dict = Depends(_get_current_user_payload), project_id: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Filter tasks by project ID"), status_filter: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, alias="status", description="Filter tasks by status"), )
methods.description: Retrieves a list of tasks filtered by optional project_id and status within caller's org.

methods.name: Task create_task( data: TaskCreate = Body(...), payload: dict = Depends(_get_current_user_payload), )
methods.description: Creates a new task in the active organization under specified project.

methods.name: dict reorder_tasks( data: TasksReorderRequest = Body(...), payload: dict = Depends(_get_current_user_payload), )
methods.description: Bulk updates the order_index of multiple tasks within a project and optional status lane.

methods.name: Task update_task( task_id: str, data: TaskUpdate = Body(...), payload: dict = Depends(_get_current_user_payload), )
methods.description: Updates specified fields of a task in the active organization.

methods.name: None delete_task( task_id: str, payload: dict = Depends(_get_current_user_payload), )
methods.description: Deletes a task within the active organization.

ctags.name: _assert_project_in_org
ctags.pattern: /^async def _assert_project_in_org(conn, project_id: Optional[str], org_id: str) -> None:$/

ctags.signature: ( data: TaskCreate = Body(...), payload: dict = Depends(_get_current_user_payload), )

ctags.name: reorder_tasks
ctags.signature: ( data: TasksReorderRequest = Body(...), payload: dict = Depends(_get_current_user_payload), )
